scripts.demo:tiles: npm run demo:fixture && npm run prepare-assets && vite --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4177 --strictPort
scripts.test:e2e:tiles: npm run demo:fixture && npm run demo:projected-fixture && playwright test e2e/tiles-pipeline.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare-assets && vite build
scripts.build:ci: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare-laz-perf && vite build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../../packages/adapter run build:library && npm --prefix ../../packages/tiles run build && tsc --noEmit
scripts.benchmark:first-visible: playwright test e2e/streaming-performance.spec.ts --grep 'records first-visible startup latency' --reporter=line
scripts.benchmark:vertical-grid: COPC_VERTICAL_GRID_BENCHMARK=1 playwright test e2e/vertical-grid-cesium-integration.spec.ts --grep 'measures Cesium vertical-grid streaming costs' --workers=1 --reporter=line
scripts.test:soak:smoke: COPC_RUN_STREAMING_SOAK=1 COPC_SOAK_ALLOW_SHORT=1 COPC_SOAK_MINUTES=2 COPC_SOAK_SAMPLE_INTERVAL_MS=15000 playwright test e2e/copc-streaming-soak.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line
scripts.prepare-assets: npm --prefix ../../packages/adapter run prepare-copc-adapter-wasm && npm run prepare-laz-perf
